name: Start OpenBCI GUI in Synthetic Mode
description:
The OpenBCI GUI is open at the System Control Panel. Your task is to start the GUI in Synthetic mode to begin streaming algorithmically-generated EEG data.

Steps:
1. In the System Control Panel, locate the data source selection panel on the left side.
2. Select 'SYNTHETIC (algorithmic)' as the data source from the list of available data sources.
3. Click the 'START SESSION' button to begin the synthetic data stream.
4. Wait for the main GUI to load with the data visualization widgets.

After completing this task, the OpenBCI GUI should be showing the live Synthetic EEG data stream with the Time Series widget displaying EEG-like waveforms for all active channels.

metadata.expected_result: Active synthetic EEG session with Time Series widget visible
